pins.name: D7
pins.label: GPIO7 (Led active high)
pins.notes: PIN_LED — onboard status LED, active-high (inferred from repo precedent — see notes.txt; no direct Zephyr devicetree exists for this exact board). Confirmed as GPIO7 via Adafruit's own learn.adafruit.com pinouts guide ("This little red LED is connected to GPIO7... in Arduino as PIN_LED") and independently via CircuitPython's pins.c (LED -> pin_GPIO7). digital_input dropped to match this repo's established led_high precedent for dedicated onboard LED pins; pwm_output kept since arduino-pico's analogWrite() works on any RP2040/RP2350 GPIO, enabling brightness dimming.

pins.name: GPIO8
pins.label: GPIO8
pins.notes:
RP2350_PSRAM_CS — dedicated chip-select line for the onboard optional SOIC PSRAM footprint (populated on product 6130, unpopulated footprint on product 6000; the CS trace is present on both). Confirmed via Adafruit's own pinouts guide explicit warning: "The chip select line for the PSRAM is broken out and is labeled PCS on the board silk. It is attached to GPIO8. If you have PSRAM onboard, DO NOT use GPIO8 as a regular GPIO!", independently corroborated by CircuitPython's mpconfigboard.h (CIRCUITPY_PSRAM_CHIP_SELECT -> pin_GPIO8). This board's own pins_arduino.h already omits a D8 general-purpose alias for this reason.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO12
pins.label: GPIO12
pins.notes:
PIN_D2P — HSTX connector TMDS/DVI data-channel-2 plus differential line, driven by the RP2350's dedicated native HSTX hardware peripheral. Confirmed via Adafruit's pinouts guide ("D2P/GPIO12") and independently via CircuitPython's pins.c (D2P -> pin_GPIO12) and mpconfigboard.h (DEFAULT_DVI_BUS_BLUE_DP -> pin_GPIO12). Not general-purpose; this board's own pins_arduino.h already omits a D12 alias for this reason.
Check if available on board

pins.name: D21
pins.label: GPIO21 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: PIN_NEOPIXEL — onboard single status NeoPixel (WS2812), output-only data line. Confirmed via Adafruit's own learn.adafruit.com pinouts guide ("the status NeoPixel LED. It is connected to GPIO21") and CircuitPython's pins.c (NEOPIXEL -> pin_GPIO21) / mpconfigboard.h (MICROPY_HW_NEOPIXEL -> pin_GPIO21). This GPIO was also the vendor's default (unused) PIN_SPI0_SS alias, which would have contaminated this confirmed NeoPixel tag with a spurious spi_ss capability - fixed 2026-07-13 by removing that alias from pins_arduino.h (CircuitPython's own DEFAULT_SPI_BUS defines no CS/SS pin at all for this board, confirming no onboard SPI device consumes it), matching the identical fix already applied to the sibling adafruit_feather_dvi and adafruit_feather_scorpio boards.
